title: [Decision] connector-mcp tool-snapshot pin (#26709 item 3(c)): one aggregate `toolsSnapshotSha256`, or a per-tool pin record that can name the tool a server rewrote
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Ruled: 6545635244 · letter B · 2026-10-31T15:53Z
Ruling-ref: 6545635244

Ruled: 6506797088 · letter B · 2026-10-29T19:52Z

carries item 3(c) of #26709; #26709 keeps item 1 (PR #27387). Filing gate: ② a contract-shape decision the maintainer takes. Raised by the os-dev on #26709 as needs_decision (report comment 6488553467); the seat's own readings below. Child of #27293 (E1). ⛔ Not a claim; item 3(c) is not dispatched while this card is open.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不改代码。#26709 第 3(c) 项（MCP 工具快照校验）在实现时发现卡上自相矛盾，拆出来请你定形状。
- 为什么改：卡上定的键是「一个总 hash」(toolsSnapshotSha256)，验收却要求「不一致时点名是哪个工具被改了」；一个总 hash 只能说「变了」，说不出是哪个，而运行中也没有「上一次正常的快照」可比。
- 风险与回滚：卡挂着期间第 1 项（openapi include）照常落地；MCP 侧暂无快照校验，现状不变（include 已挡住新增工具，挡不住已有工具被改写描述或参数）。
- 先看：下面「选项」表。
- 两分钟验证：git show origin/main:packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts | sed -n 1844,1847p（未变化的实例不重连）。
- 需要你做的：选 A / B / C / D。

## Background

#26709 item 3(c), verbatim: "providerConfig.toolsSnapshotSha256 (optional): when set, the hash of the selected tools' name + description + inputSchema (canonical JSON) is compared on every materialization; a mismatch marks the instance degraded with a message naming the changed tool, so a server-side rewrite of a tool's description or schema (the "rug-pull" class) is visible instead of silently accepted." Triage (6487372008) graded it a protocol addition, p1, domain:server.

**Governing text:** the card's own item text (above) and its acceptance line; AGENTS.md Prime Directive #12 (contract-first: refuse loudly at authoring or load, never tolerate silently); triage 6487372008 「include keeps one meaning across openapi and mcp」 (the pin should compose with include, keyed the same way).

**Protocol statement:** Metadata-protocol: added either way (a new author-written providerConfig key on mcp); Clause-②: yes (widening).

## Premises (each with its re-check)

1. One aggregate hash cannot attribute a mismatch to a tool. (Arithmetic; no re-check.)
2. An unchanged instance is never re-materialized in a running process, so there is no earlier good snapshot in memory: git show origin/main:packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts | sed -n 1844,1847p ("unchanged entries are left alone (an unchanged MCP instance is NOT reconnected)"), and the signature check at ~:1970. Read 2026-10-29T05:10Z at origin/main.
3. A degraded channel exists to report a mismatch: the provider throws ConnectorUpstreamUnavailableError and the materializer registers a degraded husk retried with backoff (degradeConnectorInstance, plugin.ts:2172). Its log wording is "upstream unavailable … retrying with backoff", which misdescribes a pin mismatch.
4. include on mcp is a name allowlist (mcp-provider.ts:223-226).

## The question

When a remote MCP server silently rewrites one of the tools an app depends on, what should the administrator see: "something changed", or "tool X changed"?

## Options

| | What it does | What the administrator sees | Effort |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | Keep the ruled single toolsSnapshotSha256; on mismatch degrade the instance with expected and observed digests | "The tool set changed" — no tool named; they diff the server by hand | domain:server S, 1 PR; no precedent |
| **B** | Replace it with providerConfig.toolsSnapshot: a record keyed by tool name, each value the sha256 of that tool's canonical name + description + inputSchema | "Tool create_issue changed" (and "pinned tool x is gone"); meets the card's acceptance line | domain:server S–M, 1 PR; #27373's offline tool can emit the record |
| **C** | Single hash plus in-process last-good memory | Names the tool only if the same process saw a good snapshot first — at cold boot (the common detection point) falls back to A | S + hidden state; not recommended |
| **D** | Drop item 3(c) for now (close not planned); include already keeps new tools out | No rewrite detection | zero |

Business meaning: A is a seal on the whole box; B is a seal on each item in the box; D is no seal yet.

## 四维分析

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：两年后的样子是「每个被依赖的远程工具都能被钉住，变了能精确报出是谁」（参照 npm/pnpm 锁文件按包逐条记 integrity，而不是给整棵依赖树一个总 hash）；B 与 include 同样按工具名为键，两把钥匙能叠用；A 只能报「变了」，逐工具的数据算出来又扔掉；C 引入依赖进程历史的隐藏状态；D 不增生但把这类攻击面留着。
- ② 实际业务拉动：板上没有客户点名要这个功能；拉动来自你 2026-10-27 对目录调研的指示（「建议 1+2立卡」），3(c) 在那张卡的范围内。零客户拉动按规则会荐 D，但该项已在你指示的范围内，所以本卡只问形状，D 留作你收回的出口。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：B 是结构化契约，一条钉错的 pin 会指向它那个工具，响亮且可定位；A 把「钉的值过时」与「工具被改写」压成同一条模糊报错，AI 和管理员都只能猜。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：A 与 B 工作量相当（都是一个 helper + 测试），都不新增门禁；D 最省。
Prior rulings read: toolsSnapshot, tool snapshot hash, rug-pull → the card's own item text and triage 6487372008 (grade and lane only, not the shape); thread: #26709; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## Recommendation

**B.** The card's purpose is to make a server-side rewrite visible and attributable, and only per-tool data can name the tool; B keys the pin by tool name like include, so the two compose. Not A: it misses the card's own acceptance line. Not C: hidden, history-dependent behaviour. Not D: the item is inside the scope you directed; D stays the exit if you no longer want it. Confidence gap: whether the degraded channel's "upstream unavailable … retrying with backoff" wording and retry loop should be specialised for a pin mismatch (it reconnects on every backoff until the pin or the server changes); under A or B the dev should name that in the PR.

Self-check: 只看①选 B；②③④ 是否翻转：否（② 零客户拉动指向 D，但该项在你已指示的范围内，只影响是否保留出口，不翻字母）。

## After the ruling

- A or B: the epic PM dispatches it to domain:server (same lane as #27387), Metadata-protocol: added, Clause-②: yes (widening), with a contract review before landing; under B the key is toolsSnapshot (record), and the card text's toolsSnapshotSha256 is retired before it ever ships.
- D: this card closes not planned; #26709 closes when item 1 lands.

## Related
